description: This Java class defines a ReadableProduct entity, extending ProductEntity, encapsulating product details such as description, pricing, images, manufacturer, and attributes, for use within the sales manager web application.

classes.name: ReadableProduct
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing a product with properties like description, prices, images, manufacturer, and attributes, suitable for presentation or data transfer in sales management web application.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Returns the final price as a string.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price as a string.

methods.name: getOriginalPrice
methods.description: Returns the original price as a string.

methods.name: isDiscounted
methods.description: Indicates whether the product is discounted.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns a list of images associated with the product.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the primary image for the product.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns a list of product attributes.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the list of product attributes.
